facts.fact: Alice Lockhart 的坟只有一块光滑的灰石，没有名字也没有年月
facts.anchor: The grave is marked by a smooth gray stone.

facts.fact: 她认定这块地方属于 Clay，不属于自己
facts.anchor: It belongs to Clay. Not me.

facts.fact: 她对着亡妻承认"我爱他"，说出口时像在念一句咒
facts.anchor: I admit to her, and saying the words aloud feels like an incantation

facts.fact: 一只蓝鹭从岸边升起，和她梦里的那只一样
facts.anchor: a blue heron—just like the one from my dreams

facts.fact: 她说：Alice 放弃的东西如今由她继承
facts.anchor: What she has given up, I now inherit.

facts.fact: 她看出 Clay 眼里有东西：像用双手抵住海不让它吞没他们
facts.anchor: Like he’s holding back the ocean with his hands

facts.fact: 她在废弃度假村前台留下的字条上签了 ELLIE WELLS-LOCKHART
字条最后两行是留给活人的话：告诉 Nana 她爱她，告诉 James 她抱歉
夜里沙滩连同岛被海撕走，他们连喊都来不及
facts.anchor: The ocean has ripped us away at night, when we couldn’t cry out against its cruelty.

facts.fact: 结尾她把过去与未来一并放开
facts.anchor: I let go of it all.
